item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue Trump. And, Paramount settles in massive merger lawsuit
item.description: CNN, MS NOW and Politico have sued Trump after the networks were suspended from the White House. And, Paramount makes concessions to resolve a lawsuit over its massive Warner Bros. Discovery merger.

item.title: Houthis try to push deeper into western Yemen, upending life, witnesses tell NPR
item.description: As the U.S. conflict with Iran drags, the Iranian-backed Houthis in Yemen have opened a new front, taking new territory and displacing more than 100,000 people.

item.title: Leaders set ambitious goals to better the world by 2030. They've made little progress
item.description: In 2015, global leaders set ambitious goals to reduce inequality, end hunger and boost education. More than a decade later, the world is nowhere near achieving much of what was promised.
